arxiv-1412-0043.title: A simple mathematical model underlying Keller’s individualized teaching method
arxiv-1412-0043.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by . Keller’s article entitled “Good-bye teacher…” [J. 1 , 79-89 (1968)] was fundamental for the development and dissemination of Keller’s Personalized System of Instruction (PSI), which was one of the central issues in the discussions on psychology and education in the 1970s and 1980s, and nowadays has attracted attention in the context of the increasing use of online education.

arxiv-2207-10243.title: A Fast, Semi-analytical Model for the Venusian Binary Cloud System 2022 A Fast, Semi-analytical Model for the Venusian Binary Cloud System – References
arxiv-2207-10243.creator: L.-K. Dai, X. Zhang, J. Cui
arxiv-2207-10243.description: Abstract The Venusian clouds originate from the binary condensation of H 2 SO 4 and H 2 O. The two components strongly interact with each other via chemistry and cloud formation. Previous works adopted sophisticated microphysical approaches to understand the clouds.

arxiv-2210-08808.title: Towards Robust k k -Nearest-Neighbor Machine Translation Thanks: This work is done when Hui Jiang was interning at Pattern Recognition Center, WeChat AI, Tencent Inc, China.
arxiv-2210-08808.creator: Hui Jiang, Ziyao Lu, Fandong Meng, Chulun Zhou, Jie Zhou, Degen Huang and Jinsong Su
arxiv-2210-08808.description: Abstract k k -Nearest-Neighbor Machine Translation ( k k NN-MT) becomes an important research direction of NMT in recent years. Its main idea is to retrieve useful key-value pairs from an additional datastore to modify translations without updating the NMT model. However, the underlying retrieved noisy pairs will dramatically deteriorate the model performance.

arxiv-2304-10209.creator: Ilia Kopchinskii, Petr Satunin
arxiv-2304-10209.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ilia Kopchinskii, Petr Satunin. The paper studies resonant generation of higher-order harmonics in a closed cavity in Euler-Heisenberg electrodynamics from the point of view of pure quantum field theory. arxiv-2308-02390.title: Recent highlights from the LHCb experiment
arxiv-2308-02390.creator: Abhijit Mathad (on behalf of the LHCb collaboration)
arxiv-2308-02390.description: Abstract The Large Hadron Collider beauty (LHCb) detector is a single-arm forward spectrometer at the LHC, designed for the study of heavy flavour physics. In this proceedings, an overview of the detector performance and a few recent results in the field of beauty and charm physics are presented.

arxiv-2401-16717.title: Scattering for the dispersion managed nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2401-16717.creator: Mi-Ran Choi, Kiyeon Lee, Young-Ran Lee
arxiv-2401-16717.description: Abstract . We consider the dispersion managed nonlinear Schrd̈inger equations with quintic and cubic nonlinearities in one and two dimensions, respectively. We prove the global well-posedness and scattering in L x 2 L_{x}^{2} for small initial data employing the U p U^{p} and V p V^{p} spaces. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 35Q55,37K60,35Q60 1.

arxiv-2412-07364.title: Response of a Cold-Electron Bolometer in a coplanar antenna system Journal: Supercond. Sci. Technol.
arxiv-2412-07364.creator: D A Pimanov, A L Pankratov, A V Gordeeva, A V Chiginev, A V Blagodatkin, L S Revin, S A Razov, V Yu Safonova, I A Fedotov, E V Skorokhodov, A N Orlova, D A Tatarsky, N S Gusev, I V Trofimov, A M Mumlyakov, M A Tarkhov
arxiv-2412-07364.description: Abstract Cold electron bolometers have shown their suitability for use in modern fundamental physical experiments. Fabrication and measurements of the samples with cold-electron bolometers integrated into coplanar antennas are performed in this study. The bolometric layer was made using combined aluminum-hafnium technology to improve quality of aluminum oxide layer and decrease the leakage current.

arxiv-2505-06528.title: Unmasking Deep Fakes: Leveraging Deep Learning for Video Authenticity Detection
arxiv-2505-06528.creator: Mahmudul Hasan
arxiv-2505-06528.description: Abstract Deepfake videos, produced through advanced artificial intelligence methods now-a-days, pose a new challenge to the truthfulness of the digital media. As Deepfake becomes more convincing day by day, detecting them requires advanced methods capable of identifying subtle inconsistencies. The primary motivation of this paper is to recognize deepfake videos using deep learning techniques, specifically by using convolutional neural networks.

arxiv-2508-00255.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Boqi Chen 1 2 , Ou Wei 3 , Bingzhou Zheng 3 , Gunter Mussbacher 2. With the rise of large language models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in using LLMs for graph model generation.

arxiv-2509-16002.title: Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Dynamic-Circuit Qubit Reuse and Grover-Based Trajectory Optimization
arxiv-2509-16002.creator: Thet Htar Su, Shaswot Shresthamali, Masaaki Kondo
arxiv-2509-16002.description: Abstract A fully quantum reinforcement learning framework is developed that integrates a quantum Markov decision process, dynamic circuit-based qubit reuse, and Grover’s algorithm for trajectory optimization. The framework encodes states, actions, rewards, and transitions entirely within the quantum domain, enabling parallel exploration of state–action sequences through superposition and eliminating classical subroutines.

pmc-11388504.title: Airborne particulate matter integral assessment in Magdalena department, Colombia: Patterns, health impact, and policy management
pmc-11388504.creator: Eliana Vergara-Vásquez, Luis M Hernández Beleño, Tailin T Castrillo-Borja, Tomás R Bolaño-Ortíz, Yiniva Camargo-Caicedo, Andrés M Vélez-Pereira
pmc-11388504.description: The relevance of atmospheric particulate matter (PM) to health and the environment is widely known. Long-term studies are necessary for understanding current and future trends in air quality management. This study aimed to assess the long-term PM concentration in the Magdalena department (Colombia).

pmc-11404372.title: Targeting pericyte retention in Diabetic Retinopathy: a review
pmc-11404372.creator: Forrest Bohler, Lily Bohler, Varna Taranikanti
pmc-11404372.description: Diabetic retinopathy is a common yet severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is the leading cause of blindness in middle-aged adults. After years of poorly managed hyperglycemia, complications begin as non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy but can then progress into the proliferative stage marked by neovascularization of the retina.

pmc-11521640.title: A preliminary study on the use of phycocyanin as a natural blue color source in toffee‐type soft candy: Effect of storage temperature and pigment concentration
pmc-11521640.creator: Recep Gunes, Ibrahim Palabiyik, Sefik Kurultay
pmc-11521640.description: In this study, phycocyanin obtained from Spirulina platensis extract was used at various concentrations as a natural blue color source in toffee‐type soft candy, and the effect of various storage temperatures (4, 20, and 40°C) on the color stability was investigated.

pmc-12450118.title: Post Capsule Endoscopy Small Bowel Cancer Rate—An Australian Data Linkage Analysis
pmc-12450118.creator: Paris Hoey, Naeman Goetz, Kimberley Ryan, Mark Appleyard, Florian Grimpen
pmc-12450118.description: PurposeSmall bowel (SB) capsule endoscopy (CE) is a well-established investigation for suspected SB pathology, but little research has evaluated the diagnostic miss rate of SB cancer. This Australian study sought to assess the risk of developing SB cancer within 36 months of a cancer-negative CE (PCSBC-3Y) using a novel root-cause analysis (RCA) method.

pmc-12685468.title: Effectiveness of Microscopic Tubular Discectomy for Improved Pain and Mobility in Far Lateral Lumbar Disc Herniation: A Systematic Review
pmc-12685468.creator: Chamath Jagoda, Samantha Spanos, Timothy L. Siu
pmc-12685468.description: Far lateral lumbar disc herniation (FLLDH) is a subtype of lumbar disc herniation marked by severe radicular and lower back pain, often accompanied by sensory and motor dysfunction. Microscopic tubular discectomy (MTD) is a contemporary minimally invasive approach for treating FLLDH, yet its superiority over conventional discectomy remains inconclusive.

uslaw-usc-t28-s4.title: 28 U.S.C. § 4 — Precedence of associate justices
uslaw-usc-t28-s4.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s4.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part I (Organization Of Courts); Chapter 1 (Supreme Court). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Associate justices shall have precedence according to the seniority of their commissions. Justices whose commissions bear the same date shall have precedence according to seniority in age.
